description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amunugoda, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511807 (23/1200126)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership rights across multiple districts. The content focuses entirely on land administration and property rights, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which covers "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and related matters. There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters present.
